rules.statement: The State Mortgage Bank is excluded from the definition of 'any other Bank' in regulation 2(l0).
rules.supporting_quote: That the State Mortgage Bank is not a "Bank" within the meaning of the words "any other Bank" in regulation 2(l0), and in view of this finding it is not necessary to consider the legal validity of the regulations

meta.parties: Ceylon Bank Employees Union v. State Mortgage Investment Bank
